Text: Just went on a quest through storage, and I think I know where my old N64 controllers might be.

This is the only thing separating me from playing Goldeneye on my new @modretro and finally living my true best life.

And yes, there are like five heavy boxes on top of this and stuff to the side balanced on those, so I have to play real life Tetris first.
